card.title: Stay Until I’m Steady
card.instruction: Keep someone present until you feel steady enough to face what comes next without them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you leave me in the new flat, count five breaths with me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was five. Shall I close the door?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not yet. Five more while I look at the empty kitchen instead of you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll wait here while you put the kettle on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay until it boils. Then I'll try pouring one cup without getting yours out.

mechanism: A extends a goodbye through breathing and kettle steps until ready to face the new flat without the visitor.
confusable: Unlike inventing chores solely to detain, the tasks must build a visible capacity to be alone.
comparison: D98-b shifts gaze from B to kitchen and plans one cup; D98-a shifts from repeated tea to a practiced announcement.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
